//: Annotated reference for every setting the API reads. Copy the values you need into
appsettings.json (non-secrets) or into user-secrets / environment variables (secrets).
This file is documentation only -- it is never loaded at runtime.
SECRETS NEVER BELONG IN THIS FILE OR IN appsettings*.json.

//LeavePlannerDB: SECRET. MySQL connection string. Required -- the app refuses to start without it.
Use a least-privilege application user (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on the
LeavePlanner schema), never the RDS master account.

//FrontendUrl: Not secret. Public URL of the React app. Used as the single allowed CORS origin
and as the base for links inside notification emails. No trailing slash.

//: Not secret -- both values are public identifiers that already travel in every
token the browser holds. They live in configuration so dev, test and production
can point at separate tenants without a code change.
Create an API in the Auth0 dashboard; its Identifier is the Audience below.
Use a dedicated test tenant for e2e runs so test users never touch real ones.
Enabled defaults to false so a half-configured environment cannot mail real
employees by accident. FromAddress and Password are required only when it is true.
For Gmail, Password is an App Password generated under Google Account > Security
